context: Two managers prep for a vendor demo
purpose: Teach: キャンセル/器具/儲かる/スクリプト/ゲート/実例/使い勝手/成り立た

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: デモの予約、急にキャンセルが入ってきた。
lines.en: A demo booking just got cancelled on us.
lines.style: Clipped, matter-of-fact. Delivery hits the problem head-on. No dwelling. Businesslike tempo, slight tension underneath the control.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 器具の使い勝手、ベンダーが自信あるって。スクリプトも整えてます。
lines.en: The vendor's confident about the equipment's usability. Script is locked in.
lines.style: Steady and reassuring. Lean into the confidence — not defensive, informative. Speak as if laying out pieces on a board. Clear enunciation on the key words.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 採算的に儲かる見込み、実例ベースで見せたい。
lines.en: I want to show the profit projections using real case studies.
lines.style: Forward-focused, deliberate. Weight on 「見せたい」 — this is the strategy that matters. Calm authority, planning mode. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ゲートを通過する顧客数、新案で成り立たせます。
lines.en: Customer throughput — I'll make the new approach work for those numbers.
lines.style: Firm and direct. Light emphasis on 「成り立たせます」 — this is ownership, not a favour. Steady eye contact level. No hedging, just commitment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Curt and genuine. Downbeat half-second. Just enough warmth to say I see you, not enough to slow momentum. Moves on.
